group_results.reason: Removing private LUT bookkeeping has no behavior of its own. The decode function uses a local entry count, and the harness uses the context through public calls.
The new local gamma tables are used only behind the gamma flag and stored-gamma guard. The flag definitions and stored-gamma input path are missing.
The changed allocation selects a local table for RGBA8 and a context allocation for RGBA16. Reachability under the harness depends on the unresolved gamma guard.
The changed LUT write runs only if the gamma guard is satisfied; the supplied flag and parsing contracts do not resolve that condition.
The changed pixel lookup uses the same unresolved gamma flag and stored-gamma condition.

build.reason: The recipe builds and links the static Meson library, but the supplied excerpts omit the Meson option definitions and the complete public header needed to verify this C++ compilation.

input.reason: Fuzzer bytes are installed as the PNG buffer, but the omitted ancillary parser is decisive for whether a valid gAMA chunk sets stored_gama.

lifecycle.reason: Each input gets a fresh valid context; the harness frees it and its output, and context cleanup frees any allocated gamma table.

control_flow.reason: The harness calls decode after size calculation, but the gamma flag relationship and the route from PNG ancillary data to stored_gama remain unresolved.
